Two full profiles and mesh-scale tolerance limits follow by exact sums and continuity. verify.py reproduces 235 exact rational projection tests plus all listed grade/full-profile checks; finite checks supplement the universal proof.

value.rationale: This is the entire naturally defined two-parameter family of discrete harmonic Dirichlet data for a canonical Poisson stencil. The sharp finite-step residual and termination classification, plus incompatible constant/ramp tolerance fractions on the same coefficient matrix, supplies structural solver insight that qualitative estimates and a numerical sample would not provide. It addresses the 2026 structural-RHS direction, without overstating generality.
